Suppression.Justification: #191 and #198: DeadLetterAsync now takes the OutboxLease it was claimed under and returns whether it moved the row, as one conditional update. The old overload moved the row for any caller, so a late mark from a host that lost its lease could overwrite the new holder's outcome.
#191: replaced by ClaimPendingAsync, which leases the rows it returns. A fetch that did not claim let two hosts polling one store dispatch the same message.
